correctness.rationale: For all p,q>=2 the graph has diameter two; its only length-two geodesic middle cells are the other corners of the induced 2-by-2 rectangle. This proves the exact equivalence of general position with P4-free incidence subgraphs, which in bipartite graphs are disjoint stars and isolates. The component exponential formula handles one-edge stars once; the maximal classification checks every isolated-vertex case and addable-edge type. The k-component construction yields all and only the displayed maximal sizes. Two-row formulas follow by direct column choice. Standalone brute tests covered all 120656 masks on nine boards and agreed with all recurrences and maximal classifications; tests are not used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: The all-size general-position polynomial for an infinite canonical two-factor Hamming family is a motivated enumerative completion of the 2024 graph-polynomial program. The simultaneously classified inclusion-maximal sets yield an exact noninterval cardinality spectrum, with an unbounded gap on the family K_2 square K_q and exact minimal/maximal multiplicities. Previously known endpoint parameters alone give no such information. The bipartite star-forest correspondence gives a structural method, not an arbitrary parameter slice.
